'''Glymphids''' were a race of [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] that came from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ploo II/Legends|Ploo II]]. They were tall and thin, with tan skin, long snouts, and suction cup-tipped fingers. The [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] was a Glymphid.

As a race, they were rod-thin with tan-skin, and had long snouts. The Glymphid had frills on their necks and rounded nodules on their torso. They had fingers which ended in suction cups.<ref name="Rebel Force: Uprising" />

[[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] was a well-known Glymphid [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Unidentified Glymphid messenger|Glymphid messenger]] tracked down [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] pilot [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on [[Nyemari]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Uprising" />
